notes.title: Free Trial Version Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
Free Trial Features:
Online multiplayer matching is fully available and play time is unlimited
Certain functions, such as gacha, room expansion, area unlocking, character selection and local multiplayer are not available.

notes.title: Available Now!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010803/42007886694c38a264d25b9ddda97d9a12d78c32.png[/img]
Kyoto, Japan – 26 September 2024 – Q-Games Ltd., in coordination with Microsoft is proud to announce that the cute and cosy co-op game All You Need is Help is now available! The announcement was made during the Xbox Tokyo Game Show 2024 Broadcast. All You Need is Help is now for sale on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Xbox/PC Game Pass, PlayStation 5, Windows and Steam. A Switch release is also planned for October 4th.

All You Need is Help is a puzzle action game where four players must work together to fit their adorable creatures into place. While players are free to move around they must use each other to rotate! The four player co-op game supports cross platform play, so whether it’s online or locally, anyone can join in the fun!

“We are really excited to bring the joy back into co-op gaming with All You Need is Help” , says Dylan Cuthbert, CEO and founder of Q-Games Ltd. “Now more than ever it’s important to reach out and connect with your friends and family. We are looking forward to seeing how everyone plays and helps each other out in this wonderful game!”

notes.title: Play ‘All You Need is Help’ at Tokyo Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
From September 26th to the 29th, we will be showing off All You Need is Help at Tokyo Game Show 2024!!

At the booth, fans will be able to check out our newest title and have a chance to receive some exciting goodies. Attendees who add All You Need is Help to their Steam wishlist or follow us on SNS can also get an exclusive  sticker. So if you are attending TGS, make sure to stop by and say hi.
